head.title: Pelusa's Pet Grooming · Dog & Cat Grooming in Gainesville, FL | Martha & Enrique
head.description: Pelusa's Pet Grooming, Gainesville FL: family-run dog and cat grooming with Martha and Enrique. 5.0 rating on Yelp. Call (754) 366-3687.
head.og_description: Family-run dog and cat grooming. 5.0 rating on Yelp. Call ahead to book.

jsonld.name: Pelusa's Pet Grooming
jsonld.description: Family-run dog and cat grooming salon in Gainesville, FL, owned by Martha and Enrique.

notas_variante_adaptada.sin_booking_online: Negocio telefonico puro (Martha y Enrique atienden ellos mismos). CTA principal = tel:+17543663687 en vez de widget de reservas.
notas_variante_adaptada.sin_precios_publicados: Ningun agregador (Yelp, Nextdoor, Yahoo Local, dogdog.org, thegoodypet.com) publica precios exactos. Servicios mostrados sin precio + 'se cotiza por telefono' en vez de inventar cifras.
notas_variante_adaptada.resenas: 8 quotes verbatim reales encontradas (Yelp via Yahoo Local/thegoodypet.com: Jerry F., Mimi C. [incompleta, no usada], Lupe M., Tess H., Jimena D. + Nextdoor: S.J., Y.B., K.W.). Se usaron 3 en el grid principal (Jerry F., Tess H., K.W.).
notas_variante_adaptada.direccion_real: Direccion publica confirmada en multiples fuentes: se uso mapa embed real en vez de sustituir por foto.
notas_variante_adaptada.ig_no_confirmado: Dos candidatos de IG encontrados (@pelusa.petgrooming y @pelusas_pet). @pelusa.petgrooming tiene bio 'We come to your home, so you don't have to!' que corresponde a un servicio de grooming MOVIL, inconsistente con el local fisico de Pelusa's en 3737 W University Ave: se descarto por alto riesgo de ser un negocio distinto. @pelusas_pet no se pudo verificar (IG rate-limited, 429, en todos los intentos). Ninguno se uso en el site ni en el registro.

reviews_disponibles.texto: Always do a great job on our two spaniels. We wouldn't go anywhere else.
Very friendly staff, reasonable prices and my dogs look great
Best groomer in town! I always trust my Charlie with them.
they work with what you need and prefer...my puppy is in great hands
I just wish they would be open more days than what they are now. But, they are incredible.
Pelusa pet Grooming! (754) 366-3687 Inexpensive and family run!!
Pelusa does a great job at the best price I have found in town.
